newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE BANK DENIES TV REPORT OF IMPROPER LOANS.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE BANK DENIES TV REPORT OF IMPROPER LOANS.

text.p: Argentina's Banco de Credito Provincial (BCP) issued a statement Monday denying a television report that it was being investigated by the Central Bank for $60 million of improper loans.

The statement, carried by state-run news agency Telam, said the 86-year-old bank based in the Buenos Aires Province capital of La Plata "categorically denies" a weekend TV report accusing it of issuing loans without suitable collateral.
BCP has 71 branches in Buenos Aires Province, which is Argentina's most populous province.

Argentina's Central Bank, contacted by Reuters, said it had nothing to say about the television report, which said the banking authority had ordered BPC to begin a capitalization program to cover the loans in question.
